name: Venezuela

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of yellow, blue and red, with an arc of eight white five-pointed stars in the center of the blue band; the state flag adds the coat of arms at the upper hoist.
flag.symbolism: Yellow is commonly said to represent the land's wealth, blue the sea and red the blood of the independence struggle; seven stars honor the provinces that declared independence in 1811 and the eighth the province of Guayana.

hook: Venezuela has three equal stripes and an arc of eight white stars in the blue; Colombia and Ecuador have a double-height yellow band and no stars.
trivia: The eighth star was added in 2006, based on an 1817 decree by Simón Bolívar adding the province of Guayana.
Angel Falls in Venezuela is the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall, at about 979 m.
